giver: Townsfolk in Reece and the villages around it (Bram the baker, Gil the ferryman) and a piglin camp's gatekeeper: each favour needs another favour first, and the chain unwinds back to whoever started it.
feel: One small favour that turns into eight: escalating errands between people, each step somewhere new, ending with a modest reward and a good story.

quests.title: Just a Loaf
quests.summary: Bram the baker in Reece would gladly give you a crusty loaf for the road, if he had any flour. The windmill on the edge of town has stopped; would you go and see what's wrong with it?
quests.reward: A bun to be going on with

quests.title: Torn Sails
quests.summary: Miller Hesk's sails tore in last night's storm and he can't grind a thing until they're mended. New sails need canvas, and canvas means Nell the weaver.

quests.title: The Broken Shuttle
quests.summary: Nell would weave canvas this minute, but her loom's shuttle snapped. Cut her a bundle of straw with a knife while you're about it, then ask Olsen the carpenter for a new shuttle.

quests.title: Only the Old Birch Will Do
quests.summary: Olsen carves shuttles from one wood only: the old birches in the woods past Reece, where the bees nest. Bring him eight logs without a single sting (a campfire under the nest calms them).

quests.title: Shuttle, Canvas, Sails
quests.summary: Olsen carves the shuttle, Nell weaves the canvas, and Hesk can finally refit his sails. Carry each piece on to the next pair of hands.

quests.title: The Fox and the Flour
quests.summary: Hesk grinds a full bag of flour, and on the road back a fox snatches it and bolts. Follow it to its den and swap it a handful of sweet berries for the bag.

quests.title: The Loaf
quests.summary: Bram finally has flour. He bakes the crusty loaf he promised, and then, since you went to all that trouble, a whole breadbox to keep it in.
quests.reward: Cooking XP, crusty bread and a breadbox

quests.title: The Ferryman's Fee
quests.summary: Gil the ferryman will row anyone across to the island village, for a fee: a good fishing net. The net-maker Ada lives in the next village along the lake shore.

quests.title: Out of Rope
quests.summary: Ada can knot a net blindfolded, but she's out of rope, and rope means flax. Farmer Tamsin grows flax in the village beyond.

quests.title: The Scarecrow's Hat
quests.summary: Tamsin won't spare a stalk until her scarecrow has its hat back. A witch's black cat ran off with it into the swamp, and nobody goes near that hut.

quests.title: A Witch's Bargain
quests.summary: The witch will give the hat back, for a pot of proper black tea brewed in a copper kettle. She's very particular about the kettle.

quests.title: Hat, Flax, Rope
quests.summary: Return the hat to its scarecrow and Tamsin gives you a sheaf of flax. Twist it into rope and take it to Ada, who knots the net while you wait.

quests.title: The Crossing
quests.summary: Gil takes the net, keeps his word and rows you out to the island village. Halfway across, the drowned come up around the boat; keep them off until you reach the jetty.

quests.title: Paperwork
quests.summary: The piglin camp's gatekeeper won't let a stranger barter without a permit, stamped by the chief's clerk. The clerk is in the big tent. Probably.

quests.title: The Ink Has Dried
quests.summary: The clerk can't write a permit: his ink has dried in the heat. He wants glow ink, from glow squid in the Overworld, because that's what the chief's permits have always been written in.

quests.title: The Cracked Stamp
quests.summary: Ink sorted, the clerk finds his stamp cracked. A brute at the camp's forge will cast a new one from a gold block, if you beat him at arm-wrestling first (survive his swings for a minute).

quests.title: Signed by the Chief
quests.summary: Stamped, but not signed: the chief is asleep, and waking him badly is how outsiders get eaten. Piglins dance to a drum; play one by his bed until he wakes in a good mood.

quests.title: Permit Granted
quests.summary: Hand the signed, stamped permit to the gatekeeper. He reads it twice, upside down, and lets you in to trade.
quests.reward: A framed permit (item frame and paper), gold nuggets
